subject.title: Cron jobs stall during AI model calls (model_call:stream_progress never completes)

question: Should this bundled issue be kept as the canonical tracker until Bugs 1 and 3 are retested, or should maintainers split the two remaining contracts into dedicated issues and close the resolved stream-stall portion here?
rationale: The evidence indicates one of three reported behaviors has been addressed, while the other two have distinct entry points and no supplied current-main resolution proof; choosing the canonical tracking shape is a maintainer workflow decision.

options.title: Split confirmed remaining bugs
options.body: Recommended: retest the main-session event and immediate-wake contracts, then create focused issues for each confirmed failure and close this umbrella once linked.

options.title: Keep one umbrella issue
options.body: Retain this issue as the canonical tracker while adding explicit sub-status for the resolved stream-stall portion and the two pending verifications.

recommendation.title: Split confirmed remaining bugs
recommendation.body: Recommended: retest the main-session event and immediate-wake contracts, then create focused issues for each confirmed failure and close this umbrella once linked.

likelyOwner.reason: Their lifecycle update already separates the stream-stall fix from the remaining wake contract and is the strongest available routing signal.
